question.en: Who sets the focus distance, and when can it change?
question.zh-cn: 谁决定对焦距离？什么时候需要更新？

summary.en: Compare a preset focus distance, manually selected distance zones, and autofocus. Then decide whether focus should hold or keep updating.
summary.zh-cn: 先分清预设焦点、手动距离档和自动对焦，再判断焦点应该保持还是继续更新。

boundary.en: A built-in lens describes how it attaches. A prime lens has one focal length. Fixed focus describes a preset focus distance. A distance zone on a focus ring and an autofocus zone in the frame describe different things.
boundary.zh-cn: 固定镜头描述镜头怎样与机身连接，定焦描述镜头只有一个焦距，固定焦点描述预设的对焦距离。对焦环上的距离档表示远近，自动对焦区域表示画面中的位置。

en: The focus distance is where the camera is set to focus. Parts of the scene a little nearer or farther can still look acceptably sharp. With a fixed-focus camera, move yourself or the subject to work within the recommended distance range.
Manual focusing puts you in charge of the distance. Some cameras let you turn a ring continuously. Others, such as Pentax 17 in Standard mode, give you preset distance zones to choose from.

With autofocus, ask where the camera should look and when it should update. The focus area is the part of the frame it can use. On the X-T5 with shutter-button AF enabled, AF-S holds acquired focus during a half-press and AF-C keeps updating. Phase and contrast detection describe how the camera measures focus. The X-T5 uses both in its hybrid autofocus system.
zh-cn: 对焦距离是相机设定要对准的距离。比它稍近或稍远的东西，也可能看起来足够清晰。用固定焦点相机时，可以移动相机或主体，让拍摄距离落在厂商建议的范围内。
手动对焦由拍摄者决定距离。有些相机允许连续转动对焦环；像 Pentax 17 的标准模式，则让拍摄者从几个预设距离档中选择。
用自动对焦时，可以先问相机该到哪里找主体，再问何时要更新焦点。对焦区域是相机可以使用的画面范围。X-T5 启用半按快门对焦时，AF-S 合焦后在半按期间锁定，AF-C 则持续更新。相位检测和反差检测描述相机怎样测焦，X-T5 的混合自动对焦使用两种方法。
